manifest.name: dsh-plugin-desktop-notify
manifest.description: Desktop notifications and a Dock/taskbar badge for DeepSeek Harness: a finished turn, a pending approval or question, and a failure, with click-through back to the session
manifest.author: chendaleiQ

bundle.text:
# The dsh-plugin-desktop-notify bundle patch.
#
# Two halves, one package:
#
# - The CLIENT half (lib/client.js, discovered through package.json
#   `dsh.client`) is where the feature lives: native notifications whose click
#   opens the finished session, plus the Dock unread badge. It needs no host
#   cooperation; the row below only keeps the bundle selectable and active.
# - The HOST half (index.js) is an OPTIONAL osascript fallback for renderers
#   where `Notification` is unavailable. It is switched off by
#   `config.enabled: false` (not by `disabled: true`, which would make the
#   bundle look inactive to the plugin manager). Turning it on while the client
#   half also runs double-notifies.
- insert:
    - id: desktop-notify
      name: 'dsh-plugin-desktop-notify'
      config:
        # Host fallback is off: the renderer half posts the banner.
        enabled: false
        onTurnEnd: true
        onApproval: true
        # Only notify while another app is in front.
        onlyWhenUnfocused: true
        frontmostAppNames:
          - 'DeepSeek Harness'
        sound: true
        soundFile: '/System/Library/Sounds/Glass.aiff'
        titleTurnEnd: 'DSH 任务完成'
        titleApproval: 'DSH 需要你确认'
        notifyOnTurnEndKinds:
          - completed
          - aborted
          - error
          - blocked
          - max-tokens
        maxBodyChars: 140
        logPath: '~/.dsh/desktop-notify.log'

readme.text:
给 DSH 加**桌面通知 + 应用图标小红点**：任务完成、等待你操作、任务失败时提醒你，点通知直接回到那个会话。

[](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-plugin-desktop-notify)
[](LICENSE)
[](https://github.com/chendaleiQ/dsh-plugin-desktop-notify)

*（真实录屏，只截取了通知区域）*

- **任务完成**——包括窗口切到后台、你在别的应用里的时候
- **等待你操作**——工具审批、提问、执行计划确认
- **任务失败**——这一轮出错时提示
- **说清楚怎么结束的**——正常完成、被拦截、输出到上限、被中止，各自一句话，不把中断说成「已完成」
- **小红点**——应用图标上显示「需要你的会话数」，你看过之后才清零
- **点击通知**——切到对应会话，而不是只把应用叫到前面

子智能体的会话默认不提醒（可在偏好里打开）。

DSH 桌面版 → 左侧栏「插件」→ 安装，填包名：

```
dsh-plugin-desktop-notify
```

装完按 **⌘R** 刷新窗口。也可以填 GitHub 地址
（`https://github.com/chendaleiQ/dsh-plugin-desktop-notify`）或本地目录的绝对路径。

存在浏览器 localStorage 的 `dsh-plugin-desktop-notify.preferences`：

| 字段 | 默认 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `notifications` | `true` | 总开关 |
| `notifyComplete` | `true` | 任务完成时通知 |
| `notifyPending` | `true` | 等待审批 / 回答 / 计划确认时通知 |
| `notifyError` | `true` | 任务失败时通知 |
| `notifyViewed` | `false` | 正在看的会话也通知（默认跳过） |
| `badge` | `true` | 显示小红点 |
| `excludeSubagents` | `true` | 忽略子智能体会话 |
| `titleComplete` / `titlePending` / `titleError` | 空 | 自定义标题，空 = 用内置文案 |
| `maxBodyChars` | `140` | 正文长度上限 |
跟随 DSH 的语言设置（设置 → 通用 → 语言）：默认中文，切成英文后通知文案同步变成英文。

渲染层控制台：

```js
__DSH_DESKTOP_NOTIFY__.capabilities()   // 平台、通知权限、小红点、服务可达性
__DSH_DESKTOP_NOTIFY__.state()          // 小红点、待处理会话、最近一次通知/点击
__DSH_DESKTOP_NOTIFY__.report()         // 上面全部 + 窗口焦点，便于排查
```

readme.section: 给其它工具用的通知接口
readme.text:
宿主半边在**回环地址**上开了两个路由，供脚本、浏览器代理、定时任务调用：

| 方法 | 路径 | 作用 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `POST` | `/desktop-notify/request` | 发一条通知，body：`{"title": "...", "body": "...", "sessionId": "可选"}` |
| `GET` | `/desktop-notify/pending` | 渲染层取走待显示的通知（脚本不用调） |
| `GET` | `/desktop-notify/turn?sessionId=...` | 渲染层确认这一轮是怎么结束的（脚本不用调） |

地址写在 `~/.dsh/desktop-notify.endpoint`，所以调用方不用猜端口：

```bash
curl -s "$(cat ~/.dsh/desktop-notify.endpoint)" \
  -H 'content-type: application/json' \
  -d '{"title":"BrowserOS 需要你","body":"有一个接管请求"}'
```

readme.section: 给其它工具用的通知接口
readme.text:
- 通知由 **DSH 自己弹出**（归属 DeepSeek Harness），不是 Script Editor
- 点通知会把窗口叫到前面；带 `sessionId` 时会切到那个会话
- 接口只监听回环地址；地址里带一个随机 token，**照抄文件里的整条 URL** 就行。
  没有 token 的请求、以及其它网页发起的跨站请求都会被拒绝
- 渲染层那条 `/pending` 走的是 DSH 自己的登录态，不需要 token
- 窗口刷新或重开**不会**补发历史未读的横幅，但小红点还在；`enabled: false` 只关 osascript 兜底，不影响接口

- 重启或刷新窗口时，已经存在的「未读 / 待审批」只恢复小红点，不再补弹横幅

- **Windows**：点通知会切到对应会话，但窗口不一定到前台——`AppUserModelID` 和主进程 focus 通道属于桌面端，渲染层插件做不到
- **通知归属**：系统通知中心里显示为 DeepSeek Harness（用的是渲染层原生通知）
- **宿主半边**（`index.js`，osascript 兜底）默认关闭；只有渲染层拿不到 `Notification` 时才需要打开

```bash
node test/client.test.mjs      # 渲染层：文案、小红点、点击链路
node test/host.test.mjs        # 宿主兜底：dryRun 下的事件处理
```

Desktop notifications and an app-icon badge for DSH: a finished turn, a pending approval or question, and a failure, with click-through back to that session.

[](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-plugin-desktop-notify)
[](LICENSE)
[](https://github.com/chendaleiQ/dsh-plugin-desktop-notify)

*(A real screen recording, cropped to the notification area.)*

- **Turn finished** — including while the window is backgrounded or another app is in front
- **You are needed** — a tool approval, a question, or a plan waiting for confirmation
- **Turn failed** — the error is summarised in the body
- **Badge** — the app icon carries the number of sessions that need you, cleared once you have looked
- **Click a notification** — it switches to that session instead of only raising the app

Subagent sessions are skipped by default.

DSH desktop → **Plugins** → Install, then paste the package name:

```
dsh-plugin-desktop-notify
```

Press **⌘R** afterwards. The GitHub address
(`https://github.com/chendaleiQ/dsh-plugin-desktop-notify`) and an absolute local
directory work the same way.

| Field | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `notifications` | `true` | Master switch |
| `notifyComplete` | `true` | Notify when a turn finishes |
| `notifyPending` | `true` | Notify for an approval / question / plan |
| `notifyError` | `true` | Notify when a turn fails |
| `notifyViewed` | `false` | Also notify for the session you are looking at |
| `badge` | `true` | Show the badge |
| `excludeSubagents` | `true` | Ignore subagent sessions |
| `titleComplete` / `titlePending` / `titleError` | empty | Custom titles; empty keeps the built-in copy |
| `maxBodyChars` | `140` | Body length limit |

The copy follows DSH's language setting (Settings → General → Language): Chinese
by default, English once the app is switched.

From the renderer console:

```js
__DSH_DESKTOP_NOTIFY__.capabilities()
__DSH_DESKTOP_NOTIFY__.state()
__DSH_DESKTOP_NOTIFY__.report()
```

The Host half exposes two loopback routes for scripts, browser agents and cron
jobs:

| Method | Path | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `POST` | `/desktop-notify/request` | Post one notification: `{"title": "...", "body": "...", "sessionId": "optional"}` |
| `GET` | `/desktop-notify/turn?sessionId=...` | the renderer asks how the last turn ended (callers do not need it) |
| `GET` | `/desktop-notify/pending` | The renderer drains what is waiting (scripts do not call it) |

The address is written to `~/.dsh/desktop-notify.endpoint`, so callers never guess
the port:

```bash
curl -s "$(cat ~/.dsh/desktop-notify.endpoint)" \
  -H 'content-type: application/json' \
  -d '{"title":"BrowserOS needs you","body":"A takeover request is waiting"}'
```

```python
import json, pathlib, urllib.request

url = pathlib.Path.home().joinpath(".dsh/desktop-notify.endpoint").read_text().strip()

Notes:

- The banner is posted by **DSH itself** (attributed to DeepSeek Harness), not by
  a script host
- Clicking it raises the window; with `sessionId` it also switches to that session
- The endpoint URL carries a random token; post to the whole URL as printed, and
  requests without it (or cross-site ones) are refused. The renderer's `/pending`
  uses the Host's own login instead
- Reopening or reloading the window restores the badge but does not re-post
  banners for facts that were already there
- The interface binds loopback only; `enabled: false` switches
  off the osascript fallback, not the interface

- **Windows**: clicking a notification switches the session, but the window does
  not always come to the front — the AppUserModelID and a main-process focus
  channel are the desktop app's to provide
- **Attribution**: the notification centre shows DeepSeek Harness, because the
  banner is a renderer-side native notification
- **Host half** (`index.js`, an osascript fallback) is off by default; switch it on
  only when a renderer cannot post notifications

```bash
node test/client.test.mjs
node test/host.test.mjs
```
